text:
Maya (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: sales pipeline + partner GTM. a few clarifications so we can move fast.
Aria (GTM): thanks! partners asked if we have a formal SLA for joint-qualified leads. what should partners expect for response times?
Noor (RevOps): proposal: partner ops triage within 8 business hours, AE outreach within 24 business hours for strategic partners, 48 for regional. draft SLA will be posted.
Liam (Sales): will those SLAs be enforced in CRM? reps need auto-assign/alerts so leads don't fall through.
Noor (RevOps): yes 8 we will add assignment rules + escalation alerts to Slack if unassigned after 12 hours.
Ana (Legal): legal note 8 the SLA language needs qualification around "outreach" to avoid implied commitments. i can provide redlines by Thu.
Maya (CEO): thanks Ana. action: legal to redline SLA, RevOps to implement CRM rules, GTM to publish partner expectations doc. deadline EOW.
Aria (GTM): partners also asked if were doing co-sell credits for trials converted via partner demos. can we confirm?
Noor (RevOps): credit on conversion = yes for approved partners, subject to partner_source tag + co-demo flag. well publish the eligibility matrix.
Liam (Sales): small ask: can we get a single-line summary sentence for reps to use when talking about credits? helps avoid confusion in calls.
Aria (GTM): suggested line: "Approved partners earn co-sell credits on first-year ACV for conversions following a partner-introduced demo." feedback?
Maya (CEO): good. one last operational ask 8 product/eng, can you enable a demo-only token bucket so partners can show real streaming without incurring prod costs?
DevBot: Deploy note: demo-token-bucket feature branch created at 1867001300. staging build scheduled. :robot_face:
Sofia (Product): pinging product here 8 demo-only buckets will be limited to 50k tokens/day per partner in beta. will surface usage in Console.
Maya (CEO): excellent. please drop any follow-ups here and Aria will consolidate into the partner playbook doc for Monday.
Liam (Sales): ack, will add a couple of rep FAQ items.
Noor (RevOps): starting CRM retro-tagging this afternoon and will share numbers in #revops.
